title: Get carriers
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get the carrier enumeration values that represents carriers in different countries or locations. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/tools/carrier_v2/|/v1.3/tool/carrier/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string| |Response parameter name and data type |`carrier_v2_id`(in the `carriers` object): number
`id`(in the `value` object): number|`carrier_id`: string
`hni_id` : string | |New response parameter|/|`countries`| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/carrier/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string| Advertiser ID | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --get -H "Access-Token:xxx" \ --data-urlencode "advertiser_id=ADVERTISER_ID" \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/carrier/ (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Return code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message |string|Return message. For details, see[Appendix-Return codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |data |object|Returned data | #|countries|object[]|List of countries or locations.| ##|country_code|string| Country or location code.| ##|carriers|object[]| List of carriers in the country or location. | ###|carrier_id|string| Carrier ID. You can include it when creating an ad.| ###|in_use|boolean| Whether the carrier can be used for targeting| ###|name|string| Carrier name | ###|value|object[]| List of HNI (MCC/MNC) IDs | ####|hni_id|number| HNI (MCC/MNC) ID. A unique combination formed from the MNC (Mobile Network Code) and MCC (Mobile Country Code), to form a home network identity (HNI)| ####|in_use|boolean| Whether the HNI ID can be used for targeting| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "20220630234500010245242163145E6D44", "data": { "countries": [ { "carriers": [ { "in_use": true, "value": [ { "in_use": true, "hni_id": "42402" } ], "name": "AE: Etisalat", "carrier_id": "4240000" }, { "in_use": true, "value": [ { "in_use": true, "hni_id": "42403" } ], "name": "AE: du", "carrier_id": "4240001" } ], "country_code": "AE" }, { "carriers": [ { "in_use": true, "value": [ { "in_use": true, "hni_id": "722310" }, { "in_use": true, "hni_id": "722320" }, { "in_use": true, "hni_id": "722330" } ], "name": "AR: Claro", "carrier_id": "7220000" }, ... ], "country_code": "AR", }, ... ] } } (/code); ```
